⭐️ Very disappointing and unprofessional experience

Unfortunately, our experience at this clinic was extremely disappointing.

We had a scheduled appointment, yet we were kept waiting for a considerable amount of time. What was even more concerning was the quality of the examination. We had paid for an exam, but no proper examination of our dog was performed. No meaningful check of the dog’s body or overall condition was done — the visit essentially consisted of administering the vaccine.

The vaccination itself was also handled in a way that felt unnecessarily rough and uncomfortable for our dog. As pet owners, we expect a basic level of patience, care, and professionalism, especially when dealing with an animal that may already be anxious.

The pricing and communication were another major issue. Before the appointment, we received an email with the quoted pricing. However, when it was time to pay, we were suddenly told that the price had increased a few days earlier, and we were charged more than the amount previously communicated. If the price had changed, we should have been informed before the appointment and before receiving the service, not at the payment counter.

Overall, the combination of the long wait despite having an appointment, the lack of a proper examination, the rough handling of our dog, and the unexpected price increase made this a very poor experience.

For a veterinary clinic, trust, transparency, professionalism, and compassionate treatment of animals should be the minimum standard. Based on our experience today, we unfortunately cannot recommend this clinic.

We LOVE coming here. We had the pleasure of getting to know Dr. Mozes while she was at a different clinic, and when we found where she went, we immediately booked in. The care they provide is incredible. Our old clinic was bought by a group of venture capitalists and the quality of care went down to an extent that could honestly be considered negligence (Bloorcourt, despite some awards they’ve won in the past, is not anywhere I could in good conscience recommend), but here the quality of care is something we are beyond impressed with. We finally have care providers again for our dogs who we fully trust to do the right thing for them, and who aren’t there just to make a buck. Their rates are reasonable and everyone is very kind and excellent communicators. The space is bright and spotless. Look nowhere else for your pet’s care, and get the peace of mind you need. Our pets can’t tell us what’s wrong, so we need quality practicers we trust to do good work. So glad we’ve reacquainted with Dr. Mozes! I trust all their techs and vets are excellent as well.

We had an amazing experience at this veterinary clinic in so many ways. They offer a promotion for new clients where the first check-up is free, which is already a great plus. On top of that, their prices are very reasonable and accessible, which makes quality care feel truly attainable.

The entire staff was incredibly kind and welcoming. Every doctor we met was attentive, gentle, and genuinely caring. Our veterinarian in particular was extremely loving, patient, and compassionate. She treated our cats with the same love and respect that I treat them with at home, which made me feel calm and reassured at all times.

The environment itself is very warm and welcoming. Our cats were surprisingly relaxed and comfortable during the visit, and they remained calm even afterward. You can really feel that this is a place where animals are treated with care, empathy, and respect.

It was truly a wonderful experience, and I highly recommend this clinic without hesitation. I’ll add a photo of my babies in case you want to see them hehe
